title: a proof under no component belongs to its home, so its seal stops at the home and reseals with it
intention: A proof outside cairn/{tools,machines,devices} (under skills/, bin/ or press_office/) belongs to its home, the directory holding its proofs/. Its seal's closure stops at that home, and a commit touching the home reseals it, the same owner rule a component's proofs obey. No dependent-proof run is added at commit or close.
why: Measured 2026-11-16 on main 4df676bab: address.component_of returns None for 70 of 793 sealed proofs (31 bin, 2 press_office, 37 across 13 skills). validation_store therefore kept their whole closure, and reseal.proofs_touching dropped every staged file with no owner. test_sail_door's seal named cairn/machines/learning_block/learning_block.py, f64b87bf0f67's commit c0e3f9428 staled it, and nothing could reseal it. 609529c846ca (q164) and 40e40e8e5d53 (q147, test_sorted_probes) each refused at close on its own home's stale seal, a walk apiece. Akien, outline 9.4.2.3.7.1: commit runs the proofs of the component the ticket changed, and his words: "we do not want to constantly be running tests 'just in case'. we talked about commit tests and broader test groups to happen once a day and once a week depending on the test. we do not run every possible dependent proof."
traces_to: Law 9 (a seal that cannot reseal reds a later ticket's close) and outline 9.4.2.3.7.1, with Akien's 2026-10-05 answer 'tool proofs: agreed' (foreground-decisions item 7).
how: validation_store._owned_by_the_proofs_component: when the proof has no component, its owner is component_root_for(proof), and the closure keeps the proof plus the ownerless files under that home. reseal.proofs_touching: a staged file with no component is owned by the deepest census home holding it. The red-first proof replays test_sail_door and test_sorted_probes.

clauses.claim: closures taken for skills/sail/proofs/test_sail_door.py and skills/sorted/proofs/test_sorted_probes_report_to_the_watch.py, over a raw list naming learning_block.py, diagnostic.py and the skill's own door.py, keep only the proof and that door.py
a staged skills/sail/door.py selects test_sail_door under a closure seal and under a pre-closure seal, and a staged bin/cmd/trash selects exactly bin's proof
a staged learning_block.py selects no home's proof, and a staged diagnostic.py selects exactly the tools/base proof

decisions.text: D1: validation_store._owned_by_the_proofs_component narrows an ownerless proof's closure to its home (component_root_for), keeping only files no component owns, and never the repo root.
D2: reseal.proofs_touching owns a staged file with no component by the deepest census home that holds it and itself has no component.
D3: the proof cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_an_ownerless_proof_reseals_at_its_home.py, one tooth per clause, rows handed in over real paths.
